explication: XMiR-Patcher is a Xiaomi-router firmware patcher. The documented entry is running the application; the source index shows firmware installation as a central operation, supported by device access, device information, firmware-image parsing, and boot activation. The tree also exposes feature unlocking, SSH and language installation, backups, and reboot operations. Those branches are included, but their wiring is not asserted where source evidence was unavailable. The parser internals are represented where the index or excerpts support relationships; unsampled source was not inspected.
